Meet the author

A mathematics educator whose textbook comes out of classroom teaching and department leadership.

Mr. Kamulegeya is a mathematics teacher who has held Head of Department roles. His 2025 book names teaching and leadership experience at Buddo Secondary School, Kibuli Secondary School and Lubiri Secondary School.
